```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HHSKwkl)

theme_set(hhskthema())

# fys_chem <- data_online("fys_chem.rds")
# parameters <- data_online("parameters.rds")
meetpunten <- data_online("meetpunten.rds")
biologie <- data_online("biologie.rds")
biologie_kenmerken <- data_online("biologie_kenmerken.rds")

waterdiepte <- data_online("biologie_kenmerken.rds") %>% 
  filter(kenmerkcode == "WATDTE", methode == "VEG%") %>% 
  add_jaar() %>% 
  select(-datum, -tijd)


biologie %>% 
  select(-contains("stadium")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(methode == "KR12", taxatype == "MACEV") %>% 
  add_jaar() %>% 
  select(-datum, -tijd) %>% 
  left_join(waterdiepte, by = join_by(mp, jaar)) %>% 
  
  group_by(mp, jaar) %>% 
  summarise(n_kreeften = sum(waarde_totaal, na.rm = TRUE),
            diepte = first(kenmerk_waarde, na_rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  filter_out(is.na(diepte)) %>% 
  mutate(diepte = str_replace(diepte, ",", "\\.") %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(diepte, n_kreeften)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~jaar) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100))


# biologie %>% filter(methode == "KR12", taxatype == "MACEV")


biologie %>% 
  semi_join(filter(meetpunten, gebied == "KRIWA"), by = "mp") %>% 
  select(-contains("stadium")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(methode == "KR12", taxatype == "MACEV") %>% 
  add_jaar() %>% 
  select(-datum, -tijd) %>% 
  left_join(waterdiepte, by = join_by(mp, jaar)) %>% 
  
  group_by(mp, jaar) %>% 
  summarise(n_kreeften = sum(waarde_totaal, na.rm = TRUE),
            diepte = first(kenmerk_waarde, na_rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(diepte = str_replace(diepte, ",", "\\.") %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(diepte2 = cut(diepte, c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 3))) %>% 
  filter_out(is.na(diepte2)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(diepte2, n_kreeften)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~jaar, axes = "all_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "diepte in m", title = "Aantal kreeften per waterdiepte", subtitle = "Alleen krimpenerwaard")

```
